name: tl-bpe-view
description: Client bundle of the BPMN editor element: bpmn-js, its BPMN font, and its stylesheets scoped to the editor.

scripts.styles: node -e "require('fs').cpSync('node_modules/bpmn-js/dist/assets/bpmn-font','src/main/webapp/style/tl-bpe-view/bpmn-font',{recursive:true})" && node ../tools/js/scope-css.mjs --package node_modules/bpmn-js --scope "(:has(> .bjs-container)) to (:scope > :not(.bjs-container))" --header resources/diagram-js-header.css --out src/main/webapp/style/tl-bpe-view/diagram-js.css dist/assets/diagram-js.css dist/assets/bpmn-js.css
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run styles && vite build
